questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of the Mediterranean climate?
choices: It has a dry summer and a wet winter
It is found in the interior of continents
It has a high annual precipitation
It is located near the equator
questions.solution: The correct option is that it has a dry summer and a wet winter, which is a defining feature of the Mediterranean climate. The second option is incorrect because Mediterranean climates are typically found on the western coasts of continents, not their interiors. The third option is wrong because these climates have low annual precipitation, not high. The fourth option is incorrect since Mediterranean climates are found in mid-latitude regions, not near the equator.

questions.stem: In which of the following climatic groups are the tropical wet and dry climates found?
questions.solution: Tropical wet and dry climates are classified under the tropical humid group, which is characterized by high temperatures and distinct wet and dry seasons. Option A is correct because it represents this group, while B refers to arid conditions, C corresponds to regions with milder temperatures, and D includes areas with cold climates.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से किस जलवायु समूह में उष्णकटिबंधीय आर्द्र एवं शुष्क जलवायु पाई जाती हैं?

questions.stem: In which region would you expect to find a humid subtropical climate (Cwa)?
choices: The western coast of South America
The eastern coast of North America
questions.solution: A humid subtropical climate (Cwa) is typically found on the eastern sides of continents, where warm, moist air from the ocean meets land. The eastern coast of North America experiences this climate due to its position relative to ocean currents and wind patterns. The western coast of South America has a different climate, the central part of Australia is arid, and the interior of Africa is not characterized by this climate type.

hi.stem: किस क्षेत्र में आप नम उपोष्णकटिबंधीय जलवायु (Cwa) की अपेक्षा करेंगे?
hi.solution: एक नम उपोष्णकटिबंधीय जलवायु (Cwa) आमतौर पर महासागर से गर्म और नम हवाओं के भूमि के साथ मिलने वाले महाद्वीप के पूर्वी भागों में पाई जाती है। उत्तर अमेरिका के पूर्वी तट जलवायु के कारण इस जलवायु की अपेक्षा करता है। दक्षिण अमेरिका के पश्चिमी तट की जलवायु अलग होती है, ऑस्ट्रेलिया के केंद्रीय भाग शुष्क हैं और अफ्रीका के आंतरिक भाग इस जलवायु प्रकार के अधिकार में नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate, technical terms are correctly used in Hindi, and the structure matches the original.

questions.stem: What is the role of forests in relation to carbon dioxide in the atmosphere?
choices: They absorb carbon dioxide during photosynthesis
They release carbon dioxide through respiration
They store carbon dioxide in the soil
They convert carbon dioxide into oxygen
questions.solution: Forests absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere during photosynthesis, which is a fundamental process by which plants convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. The other options are incorrect because forests do not primarily release carbon dioxide through respiration, nor do they store it in the soil or convert it directly into oxygen.
